Capital	expenditures1	and	technology	modernization	
Capital	expenditures 1	for	the	 three	and	six	months	ended 	June	30,	2026 	totaled	 $20.8	million	and	 $39.3	million,

expenditures¹	during	the	period	primarily	related	to	maintenance	capital	to	support	the	reliability	and	efficiency	of	
the	Company's	equipment	fleet,	as	well	as	growth	capital	associated	with	the	construction	of	Canada's	first	100%	
natural	 gas	 fueled,	 continuous,	 heavy-duty	 hydraulic	 fracturing	 fleet	 and	 the	 purchase	 of	 electric	 ancillary	
fracturing	equipment.
